prompt_text:
Simulate two bilingual software engineers (Li and Sarah) working remotely across time zones. 
Use reasoning (chain of thought) to plan a natural English–Mandarin dialogue about resolving a deployment bug, 
then output only the conversation (5–7 turns). 
Mix Mandarin and English at the phrase level, like real bilingual speech.
Include at least one of: deploy, build, bug, deadline, merge.
Use casual engineering tone, short to medium turns, 35–50% Mandarin content.
dialogue_text:
Li: Hey Sarah, I found a bug in the latest deployment. 
Sarah: 是什么问题？我看看。 
Li: It's related to a recent merge. 我觉得是我们build的时候出了点问题。 
Sarah: 我试着重新deploy一下，看看能不能解决。 
Li: Sounds good. 我们得赶紧解决，deadline就快到了。 
Sarah: 嗯，我马上开始工作。 
Li: 谢谢你帮忙，我们一起搞定这个bug。 
Sarah: 没问题，teamwork就是最重要的。
